derivation: the same as H4751 (מַר) feminine; bitter;
def: Marah, a place in the Desert

occurrences.text: And when they came to Marah, they could not drink of the waters of Marah, for they were bitter: therefore the name of it was called Marah.
And they removed from Marah, and came unto Elim: and in Elim were twelve fountains of water, and threescore and ten palm trees; and they pitched there.
